summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a 6-K reporting board approval to call an Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) on August 28, 2026, to vote on the mergers of wholly-owned subsidiaries Juno Participações e Investimentos S.A. and Tijo Participações e Investimentos S.A. into the parent. The mergers are internal restructuring steps, with Taticca Auditores e Consultores Ltda. appointed as appraiser. No price, premium, or consideration is disclosed as these are intra-group mergers accounted for at book value. The board unanimously approved the protocol and justification documents, with effectiveness conditioned on conditions precedent. This is a non-routine simplification of corporate structure; watch for EGM approval.
